Honestly, today my bookmarks are a mess — they live in different browsers, the names are whatever the page happened to be called, and I can never find anything later. So when this is done, here's what I'd want to feel different.

When I save a link, I just want to paste the address and have it sort itself out — pull in the page's title, a short description, the little site icon, maybe a picture — so I'm not typing all that by hand. And if I ever try to save something I already saved, I don't want a second copy; I'd want it to just take me to the one I already have so I can tweak it.

Then, finding things again should be the easy part. I want to search across everything — the titles, my own notes, the descriptions, the web address — without worrying about capital letters. I want to label things with my own tags and click a tag to see just those. And I'd love to stash things as "read this later" and be able to pull up just that pile when I have time, then check them off as I get through them.

I also want to keep the stuff I care about from disappearing on me — so if a page goes away later, I still have what it said saved somewhere.

That's the heart of it for me. What are you picturing so far?
